topic: Day 11 — carousel — You don't need your life's theme figured out, just the next action

slides.text: You don't need the whole [story] yet.
You need the next action, not the narrative.
Clarity usually shows up after you've already moved.
The story gets written backward, not forward.

caption:
Waiting to figure out your life's big narrative before acting is a stall tactic disguised as reflection. Clarity usually shows up after you've already moved.

Follow for one of these a day.
